fetches.source_authority: California State Assembly, Office of the Chief Clerk
fetches.content_description: Same source PDF used for the Field Act. The Riley Act is Chapter 601 of the same 1933 session, located on PDF pages 1532–1534 (printed statute pages 1531–1533).

fetches.derivation_method: pdftoppm -f 1532 -l 1532 -r 150 -png (renders PDF page 1532, which is printed statute page 1531, at 150 DPI)
fetches.content_description: First page of Chapter 601 (the Riley Act). Shows: 'CHAPTER 601.', the full official title verbatim, the approval line '[Approved by the Governor May 26, 1933. In effect immediately.]', the formula 'The people of the State of California do enact as follows:', and Section 1 (the horizontal-force resistance requirement).

Second page of Chapter 601. Shows: Section 2 (computed stresses), Section 3 (allowable working stresses defaulting to local ordinance or to the Division of Architecture), Section 4 (buildings exempted), Section 5 (penalty — misdemeanor), Section 6 (enforcement vested in local building departments; 'building department' defined).

Third and final page of Chapter 601. Shows: Section 7 (no limitation on additional local requirements), Section 8 (urgency clause), and the conclusion of Chapter 601. The page also begins Chapter 602 (an unrelated act about earthquake-damaged building reconstruction funding) which provides a clean boundary marker confirming Chapter 601 ends here.

operational_notes: An architectural error during the build session caused the Riley Act page renders to initially be saved to the wrong folder (the CSLL 1929 chapter_pages folder) due to a relative-path collision when the working directory was not where it was assumed. The error was caught immediately during a verification listing and corrected by moving the files to the correct Riley Act folder. Hash values were re-verified after the move and confirmed identical, demonstrating that file relocation does not affect cryptographic identity. This incident is recorded here as a doctrine lesson — the verification step (re-listing the folders after the save) is what caught the error before it could propagate into the manifest.

session_appendices.session_note: Evolution-layer + current-layer + sibling-standard expansion. Added: (1) 1935 Ch. 65 — first amendment, adds the agricultural building exemption that secondary sources reference but had not been primary-sourced; (2) 1935 Ch. 343 — second amendment, refines horizontal force formula by building height (20 psf above 60 ft, 15 psf below); (3) 1933 Ch. 602 (third earthquake-related act of the 1933 session: Public Buildings Reconstruction Fund using federal RFC money) as a sibling standard related to both Field Act and Riley Act; (4) current-form leginfo URLs for California Health & Safety Code sections in the California Building Standards Commission framework.
